collection.title: Mazda 3 Hatchback 2016 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mazda 3 Hatchback 2016 - 2018 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. We also have a rear wiper blade for this model, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
